title: Reading — Words, Lines, and a First Passage
label: ch:pt-primeira-leitura
canDo: I can read a Portuguese word without its article, follow a line whose subject lives inside the verb, and hold a whole passage without translating it word by word.

payoff.summary: Forty-two words of Portuguese held together by one joining word and the order of its sentences, because the track has not yet taught but or because.
